body.name: Finite-grid support program
body.construction:
\(h_m(c)=\sum_{x\in\mathcal X}\max_f\sum_{i,j}c^x_{ij}f^x_{ij}\), where each maximization is over the corresponding chain-flow polytope.  Its value equivalently equals the sum over \(x\) of
\[
\inf_{\alpha,\beta,\lambda}
\left\{\sum_i\alpha_i d_x(i)+\sum_j\beta_j\zeta_x(j)+\sum_{k,j}\lambda_{kj}\kappa^x_{kj}:
\alpha_i+\beta_j+\sum_{k<i}\lambda_{kj}\geq c^x_{ij},\ \lambda_{kj}\geq0\right\},
\]
where \(\alpha_i\) and \(\beta_j\) are free.  The primal maximum is attained; the displayed dual is defined by its infimum, without asserting dual attainment.
